capabilities: Render a GPU-accelerated graph of the vault
Group, color, and icon notes by top-level directory with presets and automatic analysis
Label repeated index.md nodes by their directory hierarchy
Highlight a selected folder's regions with Folder Lens contours
Tune ambience, display, and force settings via movable on-canvas panels
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.8.0 or newer; the README states the plugin never edits note contents and sends nothing over the network. Beta builds are available via BRAT, and building from source needs Node.js 22+, npm, and Rust.
intentEvidence: keeps graph navigation familiar and concentrates on what the native view does not provide
motivation: The author built it to reveal the shape of folder-driven, Karpathy-style LLM wiki vaults, where index.md files become navigation hubs.
problem: The core graph view shows links between files but not folder structure, leaving repeated index.md hubs indistinguishable and offering little visual control.
summary: GPU-rendered graph view with folder-based Groups, directory labels for index.md hubs, Folder Lens contours, curated palettes, and on-canvas control panels.
